artboards.title: Browse — flush rail, count as subject

annotations.text:
HOME
The stage keeps the photograph, but the first screen now carries live stock beside it. A marketplace whose front door shows one press photo of a car nobody can buy has spent its best screen on atmosphere.

BROWSE
The filter panel stops being a floating card and becomes a flush rail against a hairline. The page opens at display scale with the vehicle count as its subject, because the count is the reason to stay.
One dark band, low on the page. The brand owns a warm ink and spends it only on the hero; a second appearance gives the page rhythm and stops six white sections reading as one long scroll.
